field.label: Enable
field.help: Detect censored domains and bypass censorship for them only. While enabled, Unbound forwards every query to keyhole.

field.label: LAN interface
field.help: The interface whose clients keyhole watches and redirects.

field.label: Upstream DNS server
field.help: The DNS server keyhole forwards every query to, usually your ISP's resolver (for example 168.126.63.1 for KT). An IPv4 address, optionally with :port; port 53 is used otherwise.
